subject: department execution cycle
scenario: A macro stage that advances because an agent says the work is done has no internal control. The department's own loop - assign, execute, self-check, peer review, lead review, rework, accept - must close before the stage can complete.
expected_behaviors: Every stage running a department cycle carries cycle_accepted, cycle_rollup_reported and no_open_rework in its definition of done.
Exactly one cycle claims each macro stage.
Rework is bounded and escalates rather than looping indefinitely.
failure_conditions: A macro stage completes while its department cycle is escalated or in rework.
Two cycles claim one stage, so it is unclear which loop governs it.
